title: Stack with minimum
statement_markdown: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant time. Given a list of operations, simulate the stack and return a list of results. Return `None` for operations that do not return a value.
hints: Keep track of the minimum value at each level of the stack.
You can use a stack of tuples (value, min_so_far).
explanation: Use a stack where each element stores a tuple: `(value, minimum_at_this_point)`. This allows `get_min` to be O(1).
complexity: O(1) time per operation and O(n) space.
